listing.name: Viva Pinata — Viva Piñata Recomp (crabinacrabic)
listing.summary: The project reports garden play and save/load. A rare crash while idle at the title remains, and a full playthrough has not been established. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Viva Pinata Xbox 360 disc ISO or extracted full disc files. USA/Europe title 4D5307F2/media 690B3287/v0.0.0.1; no TU/bonus disc needed.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract own VivaPinata disc and build Windows project; Russian translation is separately supplied.

warnings: The project reports garden play and save/load. A rare crash while idle at the title remains, and a full playthrough has not been established.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
